messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Incident detected: sudden spike in 5xx across gateway -> service-A. Alerting channel and paging oncall. (error-rate > 8% in last 2m)

omar (oncall): I got paged, looking. Any customer-facing reports?

sara (support): A few customers submitted errors in the last 10m, support case IDs 5432, 5437. Symptoms: timeouts then 502s.

lia (sre): Seeing elevated 5xx in Grafana for service-A upstreams. Top symptom is Envoy 502/503 from upstream cluster. 

benji (infra): Traffic shift out of service-A recently? We deployed a route weight change 12m ago. Rolling back would be noisy.

noah (runtime): Dumping envoy stats now, looks like retries are amplifying failure. envoy.cluster.service-A.retry.* counters spiking.

omar (oncall): Can someone paste the top counters/logs?

noah (runtime): Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T16:02:11Z] envoy error upstream connect failed: connection refused
[2026-03-15T16:02:12Z] envoy: 502 from upstream service-A-3 (conn reset)
```

lia (sre): Also see circuit_breakers.cx_overflow for cluster service-A climb. Looks like backend pod flapping + aggressive client retries.

omar (oncall): Initial mitigation idea: disable automatic route retries at the gateway to stop amplification. Can we push a quick runtime patch?

benji (infra): We have a dynamic xDS patch path. I can push a retry policy toggle to zero for that route. Prep patch now.

noah (runtime): +1. Also consider raising cb thresholds or evicting bad hosts. But first stop retries.

deploy-bot: deploy started by benji: envoy-runtime/patch-retry-disable -> canary to gateway fleet (5%): build 0.41.7

lia (sre): I'll watch error rate and cx_overflow. If it drops, we can expand.

omar (oncall): Noted. Sara, keep support loop updated that we're mitigating, request logs from impacted customers.

sara (support): On it. Sending templated message.

10m later

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: envoy-runtime/patch-retry-disable canary -> 5% passed health checks

lia (sre): Error rate dropped to ~3% in canary group, cx_overflow decreasing. This seems to be the amplification vector.

omar (oncall): Good. Benji, promote to 50% then 100% when ready.

benji (infra): Promoting now.

deploy-bot: rollout to 50% -> success.

lia (sre): 50% rollout shows global error rate down to 1.8%. Traces show fewer repeated retries.

benji (infra): Rolling to 100%

deploy-bot: rollout to 100% -> success.

noah (runtime): Confirmed: retries stopped at gateway, downstream 502s reduced. Circuit breaker metrics stabilizing.

omar (oncall): Customer impact assessment: approx 12 min of elevated errors affecting ~0.8% of requests; 6 supported customers reported errors with timeouts/502s. No lasting data loss.

sara (support): Updating cases with mitigation timeline and root-cause note: retry amplification + backend flapping on service-A after route weight change.

lia (sre): Root cause analysis (prelim): combination of small subset of unhealthy pods in service-A (OOM restarts) + an aggressive retry policy at the gateway that retried 3 times per failure. Retries increased load on remaining pods, triggering cx_overflow and subsequent 502s.

omar (oncall): Action items: 
- lia: run healthcheck audit on service-A pods, add pod-level memory guardrails (ETA 24h)
- benji: review recent route weight rollout process, add canary schedule to avoid large weight shifts (ETA 48h)
- noah: add defensive retry caps and jitter in gateway config, and add circuit breaker alert refinement (ETA 24h)
- sara: customer comms summary and followup (ETA 2h)

lia (sre): I'll also add an eval to our canary dashboards to surface cx_overflow early.

benji (infra): Note: we'll restore retries to a safer config after backend health fixes. We'll capture the patch diff in PR 789.

omar (oncall): Any remaining tasks before I close the incident channel?

noah (runtime): I'll keep an eye for next 30m, but looks stable.

sara (support): Support updated customers, all cases acknowledged.

lia (sre): Leaving followup postmortem template in #postmortems and assigning owners.

omar (oncall): OK closing this live thread, re-open if regressions. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
